4. The prosecution case, in a nutshell, is that, Md. Arif Hasan (P.W.01), son of the deceased Tofazzal Hossain as informant lodged a First Information Report on 07.02.2007 with the Kendua Police. Station against the convict-appellants along with others under sections 143/447/323/326/302/307/114 of the Penal Code, alleging inter alia, that on 07.02.2007 at 9.30 A.M. he along with his father, paternal uncle and paternal cousins was engaged in removing water-hyacinths from the purchased land of his, paternal cousin namely, Sharmin Akter. At that time the FIR named accused Bablu; Shahed, Raton, Kadir and .Sultan being equipped with deadly weapons forming an unlawful assembly came to the place of occurrence and accused Shahed ordered them to leave the place disclosing that they would not allow them to cultivate the land as he failed to purchase the same. But the victim Tofazzal Hossain refused to leave the place. Thereafter, on order of accused Shahed, accused Katon and Faruk grabbed the victim Tofszzal Hossain and inflicted knife blow on the neck of the victim Tofazzal Hossain which caused serious injury. Accused Abdul Kadir dealt a dao blow on the right thigh of the informant's uncle Bahar Uddin and caused serious injury. Accused Sultan dealt a Ramdao blow on the left hand of Bahar Uddin which caused serious injury and other accused persons dealt lathi blows on various parts of Bahar Uddin and other witnesses. Eventually, the injured victim Tofazzal Hossain and Bahar Uddin were taken to the adjacent Tarail Upazilla Health Complex wherein the duty doctor declared the victim i.e. Tofazzal Hossain as dead and injured Bahar Uddin was admitted to said Health Complex in a critical condition. On lodgement of FIR Kendua Police Station Case No. 04 dated 07.02.2007 was started. 

 5. Sub-Inspector Abul Khair being entrusted with the task of investigation visited the place of occurrence and pre-pared the Inquest Report of the dead body in presence of witnesses and the dead body was duly sent to the hospital for holding post-mortem. Thereafter, the investigation officer prepared the sketch map of the crime scene with index, seized alamats by preparing seizure list and examined witnesses under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. Then he collected the injury certificate as well as post-mortem report. The investigating officer after completion of investigation submitted police report on 23.04.2007 under section 173 of the Cr.PC recommending prosecution of 06 (sue accused persons including the present convict-appellant and petitioners under sections 143/447/323/324/302/114 of the Penal Code. 

 6. Thereafter, the case record was transmitted to the learned Sessions Judge, Netrokona, for trial wherein the same was registered as Sessions Casb No.119 of 2007. Then cognizance of the offences was taken under sections 143/447/323/ 324/302/114 of the Penal Code. 

 7. On 15.08.2007, learned Sessions Judge, Netrokona, framed charge under sections 143/447/323/324/302/114 of the Penal Code against the accused persons including the present convict-appellant and petitioners and the same was read over and explained to them who were present on dock to which they pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried. 

 46. In reply to cross-examination P.W. 09 says that he went to the spot immediately after the; occurrence, which is located near the house of Chand Minh. He found the dead body lying at about 20/40 cubits away from the house of Chand Miah. He found the seized crime knife in the hand of Daroga. He put his signature in the seizure list. 47. P.W. 10 S.I. Md. Abul Khayer is the investigating officer of the case. In his testimony he stated that after receiving the task of investigation of the case he (P.W 10) visited the place of occurrence and prepared sketch map along with separate index, seized the knife and some blood stained soil vide seizure list dated 07.02.2007, recorded the statements of witnesses under section 161 of the Code and collected the injury certificate, inquest-report and post-mortem report. After proper investigation, he (P.W 10) submitted charge-sheet no.77 dated 23.04.2007, under sections 143/447/323/ 302/326/307/114 of the Penal Code against the accused persons. He marked the F.I.R form and the signature of the recording officer thereon, sketch map and his signature thereon, index and his Signature thereon as Exhibits- 4, 4/1, 5, 5/1, 6 and 6/1, respectively. He proved the seized knife and blood stained soil as Materials Exhibits-I & II.
